messages:
aj: Nightly eval alert: new quant5 variant failing multiple suites — spike in blank outputs and coherence drop. Getting a lot more '' answers in fewshot-instruct. Sev initially P2.

eval-bot: ALERT: nightly-eval run: model=new-model-v2-quant5; failed_suites=[fewshot-instruct:+120%, longform-coherence:+35%, safety-finance:+10%]; report=https://internal-evals/3729999999 :rotating_light:

aj: Reproduced locally on staging-mirror. Quick sample:
```
prompt: \"Summarize the following financial statement...\"
output: \"\"
```

jing: I'll own triage. First hypothesis: quantization kernel or tokenizer change. Kicking off int/FP parity runs + tokenization diffs.

maria: I'll audit the promptset and pull the top 50 failures. Any config changes (temp/seed) in the nightly run?

aj: Nightly pinned to commit c3f9a and quant profile 'quant5-sparsefp'. Quant conversion job exit: 0. Pasting short conversion log excerpt:
```
quantize: success
warnings: quant-warn layer12, layer21
kv-cache: unchanged
```

eval-bot: Note: nightly also ran new llmlib kernel on dedicated pool at 01:15UTC (ops rollout).

ops: Confirmed — we rolled llmlib v2.7 -> v2.8 to dedicated yesterday at 01:15. Canar y rollback started just now for the failing pool.

jing: Running deterministic reproduce with seed=42, temp=0.0, and a non-quant baseline. Also diffing tokenizer token ids for failing prompts.

maria: Found pattern: several fewshot templates include trailing whitespace + unicode NBSP. Tokenizer v1.4 strips differently than v1.3 — could explain empty outputs when context trimmed.

aj: Initial severity: P2 (fewshot customer flows affected). Owners: jing (investigate), maria (promptset cleanup), ops (kernel rollback/observe). I'll file follow-up ticket and link here.

jing: Early result — tokenizer revert to v1.3 in a quick run reduced blank outputs by ~85% on sample set. Pushing full eval run now.

maria: If tokenizer revert holds, I'll sanitize templates and add explicit normalize step in eval harness.

aj: Great work team. Keep updates in this thread. If perf regression shows up after rollback, we'll escalate. :thumbsup:
